prompt: Reductive amination: cyclopentanone + benzylamine (PhCH2NH2) with NaBH3CN, cat. AcOH. Draw the amine product.
explanation: Primary amine + ketone → iminium (under mild acid), which NaBH3CN selectively reduces (over the starting ketone) to the amine. This is the preferred route to secondary amines — one-pot and clean.
